hero.definition: Porcelain veneers are thin shells of ceramic, as thin as 0.3 mm, bonded to the front of your teeth to change their shape, length and color. At Xiluet Smiles in Miami, 20 veneers cost $6,000, take three visits in one week, and carry a 5-year written warranty.
hero.lead: Little to no drilling, a design you approve before any tooth is touched, and delivery in one week in Miami. Covered by a 5-year warranty, in writing.

image.alt: Woman smiling with natural-looking porcelain veneers
image.caption: 20 porcelain veneers · 0.3 mm · 5-year written warranty

items.d: Tetracycline, fluorosis or deep internal discoloration.
Teeth shortened by grinding or old bonding that keeps breaking.
Closed in one week, without years of aligners.

When a straighter look matters more than moving roots.

why.title: Thin enough to keep your teeth. Strong enough to last.
why.body: Our veneers are hand-finished by a ceramist in the same building as your doctor. That is why we can go thinner, match shade in person, and deliver in days instead of weeks.

price.title: One price for 20 veneers, confirmed in writing before you book
price.body: Send photos, and a doctor writes your estimate within 6 hours. The number you see is the number you pay, unless your exam finds something that needs treating first, and we tell you that in writing too.
price.footnote: Prices shown are minimum fees. Your final fee is confirmed in writing after a doctor's evaluation.

faq.title: Veneer questions, answered by the doctors

items.a: Most patients feel pressure, not pain. The area is numbed for preparation, and mild sensitivity usually settles within a few days.

items.q: How much of my tooth is removed?
items.a: With 0.3 mm veneers, usually very little and sometimes none. Your doctor confirms this at Visit 1 after the scans.
Not if they are designed for your face. You see and approve the design before any tooth is prepared, and shade is matched in person.

items.q: How long do porcelain veneers last?
items.a: With normal care, 10 to 15 years is typical. Ours are covered for 5 years in writing, and a night guard is recommended if you grind.

items.q: Can I really do this in one week?
items.a: Yes. Our lab is in the same building, so design, preparation and delivery happen across 3 visits in as little as 4 business days.
